items.title: Andrew Bailey Interview, 1959-09-26
items.q: He used to stay around my house too. Yeah, all of them come from around the 7th Ward.

ctx.x: Did you ever know any of the musicians that worked there? I think it was mostly a white band, of course.

Yeah, yeah, I didn't know much of the musicians there. The reason I didn't go to that show, because it was most French. French opera, nothing but French. That's the real time they really had the French. The same way they had the theater. You want to talk about the theater? About the theater, the Dolphin Theater. Used to have bowler shows. That was my daddy's time. I couldn't go to them shows. But that was some of the wonderful days, them days, of the day. Because today you couldn't have them with the young…
Do you remember when they started using San Jacinto Hall for when they built it?
